description: "What is X" / "who is X" / "tell me about X" / "Wikipedia summary of X" / "biography of X" / "history of X" — fetches the Wikipedia article extract (title, description, thumbnail, lead-paragraph extract) for any topic, person, place, event, or concept. Use whenever an agent needs a quick encyclopedic reference. Defaults to en.wikipedia.org; pass project/lang for other Wikimedia projects or languages. Example: page_summary({ title: "Albert Einstein" }).

title.description: Wikipedia article title, e.g. "Albert Einstein", "Python (programming language)", "World War II".

name: page_summary
